title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. My income is from two kind of sources one is absolutely halal (i.e from my salary and ancestral land) and other portion is from (bribes, interests etc.). My questions is that if I spend part of my money from halal portion in charity i.e. donation towards construction of mosque or similar things, will it be acceptable to Allah and the prayer of the people offering in such mosques with full knowledge of my financial background will be valid?? 2275 views Q. I give zakah regularly and tax is also deducted from my salary every month from my salary 1970 views Q. Zakat on Under construction Flat whose Installment is being paid and property is still not registered under my name. 7688 views Q. Can a servant of Syed be given zakat ? 3540 views Q. 1.I have a question regarding sadaqah.There is a hadith which says the best sadaqah is money spent on the members of household. 7371 views Q. Assalam valaikum, My sister's husband is aged very poor no one to support him. And add to his misery he has one mentally retarded son of 22 years old. He is SYED therefore can we give zakat to our sister who is not SYED. Can we motivate others also to give her zakat? 1756 views Q. I am President of Khairul ummat Charitable trust and we have recieved a request to extend help to SYED for his cancer treatment. 1860 views Q. I want to know on what things we have to give zakah. 1744 views Q. Giving zakath to jobless and debted father 3118 views Q. Use of Zakat Money 2050 views Q. Assalamualaikum Q)Islamic School has collection of zakaat money can the money be given to children (whos perents are in debts or the parents are finding it difficult to pay the fees)or to there parents to pay the School fees not telling them that this is zakaat money? 1635 views Q. My company have given me the options to buy 100 shares of the company at $50 each. (Stock options). These options are not transferable. Today The price of shares is $75 each. I have not yet exercised my right to buy @50. I have intentions to buy these shares @50 once the market price is $100. DO I have to pay zakat on this right to buy shares at this moment in time? This option will expire in the next 4 years (mening i have to excercise this right within next 4 years). 3503 views Q. Can we give the interest money from saving accounts to poor relatives? 2529 views Q. Zakat's use on Hospital equipment? 2846 views Q. My mother-in-law is a widow and she is earning Rs.13,000 every month from her pension, her husband's half pension and also through rent.Whenever she has to pay zakat she will cry that she has to give so much and now she says some one has said to her that as now she is widow now she can ask her sons to pay zakat. Is it correct that her son can pay zakat? As she doesn't spend a single amount on her sons. 5783 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 163403 Country: India Title: I am a student and I don't earn my money yet. So the money I have is my parents. Can I give charity out of that money? Question: I am a student and I don't earn my money yet. So the money I have is my parents. Can I give charity out of that money? Answer ID: 163403 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1091/922/N=11/1439) If your parents allow it or your parents give the money into your complete possession then you may give those money in charity and sadaqah. According to Shariah, there is no harm in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
